title: CSS Bed: Classless CSS themes to use as starting points in web development
summary: CSS Bed is a curated collection of classless CSS themes that provide minimal, ready-to-use styling for semantic HTML. It allows developers to quickly prototype or build websites by selecting from multiple pre-built design themes without adding class names to HTML elements.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need to write CSS from scratch by providing multiple classless theme options that work with plain semantic HTML.
why_valuable: Accelerates web development workflow by offering instant design starting points while maintaining semantic HTML structure and clean code practices.
